criteria.description: Zig service builds, reports health, serves static assets, and exposes a stable HTTP boundary.
criteria.evidence: zig build; live GET /healthz and GET / returned 200
criteria.notes: Validated against the local CSV snapshot.

criteria.description: Available tax years are discovered and published.
criteria.evidence: --check reported 1 year; GET /api/v1/years returned [2026]
criteria.notes: Only the locally available 2026 source was used.

criteria.description: Parcel identifiers remain twelve-character text values with leading zeroes preserved.
criteria.evidence: ingest.Property stores a fixed text parcel ID; tests/ingest_test.zig; docs/file-format contract
criteria.notes: No numeric parcel-ID conversion is used by the Zig importer.

criteria.description: Required comparable and tax fields are retained when present.
criteria.evidence: ingest.Property fields and tests/ingest_test.zig
criteria.notes: Validated against the local enhanced CSV header.

criteria.description: Invalid rows, duplicates, checksums, import reports, and atomic version publication are all provided.
criteria.evidence: ingest rejects invalid/duplicate rows; checksum and atomic publication are absent
criteria.notes: Partial ingestion validation is implemented; production publication remains staged.

criteria.description: PolymorphDB provides durable native provider operations, indexes, aggregations, projections, and restart recovery.
criteria.evidence: provider/provider.zig is a documented seam with an in-memory fixture; durable adapter is absent
criteria.notes: Requires the production PolymorphDB integration contract and persistence validation.

criteria.description: CSV-backed parcel IDs are joined to county geometry and geometry is version-cached.
criteria.evidence: GET /api/v1/map returns an empty collection; property geometry is null
criteria.notes: No new GIS data was pulled per owner direction.

criteria.description: Address and exact parcel-ID search return disambiguated CSV-backed results and not-found states.
criteria.evidence: GET /api/v1/properties/search and unknown-property 404 smoke checks
criteria.notes: Search is bounded and read-only.

criteria.description: Property detail displays tax, assessment, effective-rate, characteristics, source, and freshness information.
criteria.evidence: property response contains basic tax/rate/context fields; special assessments, full characteristics, source version, and freshness are absent
criteria.notes: Detail response is an initial baseline, not the complete product contract.

criteria.description: Effective rate is Total_Tax / Market_Value and unavailable for zero or missing market value.
criteria.evidence: comparable.effectiveRate and comparable tests
criteria.notes: Zero market value returns zero in the current internal representation and needs an API unavailable marker for the final contract.

criteria.description: Year-by-year tax history and comparable statistics are displayed.
criteria.evidence: Single-year property response; history route and complete year-by-year response are absent
criteria.notes: Cannot validate historical behavior from the single local year alone.

criteria.description: Comparables use county-only hard tax-context eligibility followed by physical similarity.
criteria.evidence: comparable.eligible and comparable.find; tests/comparable_test.zig
criteria.notes: The direct comparable baseline excludes tax rate from similarity.

criteria.description: Levy code, class, homestead, and neighborhood context are explicit comparable filters.
criteria.evidence: comparable.eligible implementation and tests/comparable_test.zig
criteria.notes: Blank-context compatibility is documented in the implementation.

criteria.description: Physical similarity applies the specified characteristic weights, including structure/stories/basement.
criteria.evidence: weighted living/value/year/acreage/bed/bath/stories score; structure and basement are not scored
criteria.notes: The baseline score is incomplete relative to the full requirement.

criteria.description: Configurable tolerance gates include urban/rural lot rules.
criteria.evidence: fixed living/value/year/bed/bath gates; configurable and urban/rural lot gates are absent
criteria.notes: Requires a follow-up comparable-engine iteration.

criteria.description: Tax outcomes are excluded from matching, subjects are excluded, and ties are deterministic.
criteria.evidence: tax rate is not an input and subject parcel is excluded; tie-break by parcel ID is absent
criteria.notes: Partial invariant only; deterministic tie resolution remains outstanding.

criteria.description: Fifteen peers are selected by default with a configurable 10-20 range and insufficient-peer state.
criteria.evidence: fixed bounded candidate buffer; configurable range and explicit fewer-than-five state are absent
criteria.notes: Current baseline returns available peers with confidence labels only.

criteria.description: Comparable median, quartiles, anomaly, confidence, excess tax, and plain-language flag are exposed.
criteria.evidence: median, quartiles, count, and confidence are present; anomaly/excess-tax/flag are absent
criteria.notes: Requires completion of the property-detail response contract.

criteria.description: Comparable-relative and county-wide effective-rate percentiles are available for every year.
criteria.evidence: ranking percentile helper exists; both percentiles are not exposed by the property API
criteria.notes: Single-year local data also prevents validating year cycling.

criteria.description: Read-only property, history, comparable, ranking, geometry, year, freshness, and CSV export APIs are exposed.
criteria.evidence: health, years, search, detail, rankings, map, and tile-policy routes exist; history/comparables/geometry/export routes are incomplete
criteria.notes: No upload or authentication routes are present.

criteria.description: MapLibre-compatible OSM-derived tiles are served through a seven-day cache with CSV-backed coverage gating.
criteria.evidence: tile policy and attribution seam exist; route intentionally returns 403 until geometry coverage and upstream cache are populated
criteria.notes: No new geometry/tile source was pulled per owner direction.

criteria.description: Property and county map views provide keyboard operation, focus, accessible tables, color-safe legends, and non-color cues.
criteria.evidence: desktop UI shells and legend/list exist; geometry-backed map and full accessibility audit are not complete
criteria.notes: The UI baseline is present but not release-ready.

criteria.description: Operator import rebuilds derived data and publishes it atomically.
criteria.evidence: --check imports in memory; import publication and atomic rebuild are absent
criteria.notes: Requires durable provider and operations implementation.

criteria.description: Reproducible tests, Linux benchmarks, accessibility, dependency/license, and abuse/rate-limit validation are complete.
criteria.evidence: zig build test passed 2/2; license and validation docs exist; benchmark/accessibility/rate-limit proof is absent
criteria.notes: Only the available local build and smoke checks were run.

negative_invariants.description: No public upload or mutation endpoint exists.
negative_invariants.verification_method: automated HTTP smoke test and source review
negative_invariants.evidence: app/app.zig rejects non-GET requests; no upload route; live API smoke check

negative_invariants.description: Unknown parcel IDs are not returned from the local CSV-backed service.
No non-CSV parcel geometry or tile coverage is exposed.
negative_invariants.verification_method: automated HTTP smoke test and source review
negative_invariants.evidence: geometry is null and tile route returns 403 without a coverage index
